id.description: Unique identifier of the memory block.

content.description: Text content of the memory block.

system_prompt_amendment.description: System prompt amendment for agent mode.

injection_mode.description: Where memory content is injected. 'system_prompt' adds it to the LLM system prompt; 'user_instruction' prepends it to the user message; 'agent_file' makes it only available as AGENTS.md in agent mode; 'agent_tool' exposes content lazily via the read_memory_block / update_memory_block tools (no pre-injection).

access_mode.description: Controls whether the LLM/agent can read the memory, write to it, or both.

user_id.description: ID of the user who owns the memory block.

created_at.description: When the memory block was created.

updated_at.description: When the memory block was last updated.

is_public.description: Whether the memory block is publicly accessible.

is_owner.description: Whether the current user is the owner.

max_content_length.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in memory content. 0 means unlimited.

is_auto.description: Whether this memory block was auto-created by the system for an AI assistant or chat session.

user_count.description: The number of users the memory block has been directly shared with (excludes the owner).

group_count.description: The number of groups the memory block has been shared with.
